description: A task's or a chat's ask of a person, kept by its host (state folder's inbox/) till it's answered or withdrawn: across the host's restarts; a task's stopped then (its run gone), a chat's once its chat's archived or deleted, struck through and its buttons off. Every head that may manage the asking Bot or chat is told it as it changes (inbox_changed).

session.description: The asking chat's session id: a task's Bot's, or the chat whose model raised it.

bot.description: That chat's Bot's name, if it's a Bot.

chat.description: A chat's own ask (task null): the chat's name as it raised it (its Bot's, else its title).

task.description: The task's id; null for a chat's own ask (its model's, with its chat's tools).

task_name.description: The task's name; null for a chat's own.

run.description: The asking run's id; null for a chat's own.

at.description: When it was raised (seconds since the epoch).

status.description: waiting: for an answer; answered (answer: how); withdrawn: its task or chat took it back; stopped: its run ended (or its host restarted), or its chat was archived or deleted, with it unanswered.

versions.description: Every version of it, oldest first: the last is what's answered.

proposal.description: A model's answer waiting to be confirmed, if one was asked for.

sent_to.description: The Bot it's been sent to answer (its session id), till it does.
